datasets.name: rows
queryLines:
SELECT account_name AS name, SUM(net_revenue) AS amount,
  CASE WHEN SUM(net_revenue) >= 1000000 THEN 'Green'
       WHEN SUM(net_revenue) >= 250000 THEN 'Yellow' ELSE 'Red' END AS status
FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.fact_sales
GROUP BY account_name ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 20
